+    def solve(data):

+        roots = data["roots"]

+                   for name in names]
+        rows_by_version = {name: {row["version"]: row for row in rows}
+                           for name, rows in packages.items()}
+
+        for vector in product(*domains):
+            selected = {name: version for name, version in zip(names, vector)
+                        if version != -1}
+            if any(name not in selected or not low <= selected[name] <= high
+                   for name, (low, high) in roots.items()):
+                continue
+            if any(name in selected and
+                   (selected[name] in blocked.get(name, []) or
+                    (name in pins and selected[name] != pins[name]))
+                   for name in names):
+                continue
+
+            edges = {name: [] for name in selected}
+            closure = set(roots)
+            pending = list(roots)
+            valid = True
+            while pending and valid:
+                name = pending.pop()

+                    valid = False
+                    break

+def _schedule():
+    from collections import Counter
+    from itertools import combinations
+
+    def solve(data):
+        jobs = data["jobs"]
+        k = data["k"]
+        blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+        mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+        quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+        best_ids = None
+        best_value = None
+        for subset in combinations(jobs, k):
+            ids = {job["id"] for job in subset}
+            if ids & blocked or not mandatory <= ids:
+                continue
+            counts = Counter(job["group"] for job in subset)
+            if any(not low <= counts[group] <= high
+                   for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+                continue
+            ordered = sorted(subset, key=lambda job: (job["start"], job["end"]))
+            end = -1
+            compatible = True
+            for job in ordered:
+                if job["start"] < end:
+                    compatible = False
+                    break
+                end = job["end"]
+            if not compatible:
+                continue
+            selected = sorted(ids)
+            value = sum(job["value"] for job in subset)
+            if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                    (value == best_value and selected < best_ids)):
+                best_value, best_ids = value, selected
+        if best_ids is None:
+            return {"error": "impossible"}
+        return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}
+    return solve
